name: M3_OIS010MI_Get
description: Retrieve full configuration details for a single customer order type as defined in **CO Type. Open (OIS010)**. The operation returns one record, containing identification and description (order type, category, description, name, status), order entry controls, pricing and discount rules, tax and invoicing settings, logistics and supply parameters, and statistics options. This lets external solutions read exactly how a customer order type behaves in M3, including whether it is a normal order, credit, quotation, deposit-based, internal sales, etc. Attached order charges are not included; they are handled by separate list operations for order type charges.
